_README: Maps each corpus PDF to the scheme metadata stored in its Qdrant payload (ING-5).
Not used in retrieval — these values only label chunks in the Gemini prompt.
scheme_name: taken verbatim from the document's own title page, never inferred from the filename.
year: the academic year / effective date the document states it applies from. null = the document does not state one.
Keys must match filenames exactly, including spaces and capitalisation.
